visualDescription.sceneDescriptionEn: A black and white engraving depicting a confrontation on the deck of a ship. A man in a dark coat and light trousers stands in the center, appearing to be in a struggle or altercation with two other men. The man on the left wears a dark, textured garment and a head covering, while the man on the right wears a light-colored wrap or dhoti and a turban. The background shows ship rigging, masts, and a crowded deck with other indistinct figures.
visualDescription.visualObjectsEn: Ship deck, masts, rigging, ropes, clothing (coats, trousers, turbans, wraps), wooden structures, indistinct crowd of people.
visualDescription.recognizableCharactersOrPeopleEn: Three primary figures in the foreground: a man in a Western-style coat and hat, a man in a dark textured outfit, and a man in a light-colored wrap and turban. A crowd of indistinct figures is visible in the background.
